enabled.description: Master switch. When false, HistorySearch/HistoryRead return a disabled notice.

sessionsDir.description: Override pi's sessions base directory. When null, resolves from $PI_SESSIONS_DIR then ~/.pi/agent/sessions. A leading ~ is expanded.

indexOnStart.description: Run an incremental index of the current project on session_start.

includeToolResults.description: Index tool-result messages too. Larger index, higher recall.

maxResults.description: Default number of sessions returned by HistorySearch.

snippetsPerSession.description: Number of matching snippets returned per session.

branchAliases.description: Optional manual aliases keyed by branch/session id.

contextGuard.description: Context-overflow guard: truncate large tool results to fit the remaining context window, with a warning.

charsPerToken.description: Approximate characters per token for char→token budget math.

maxContextFraction.description: Max fraction of the remaining context window a single result may consume. The rest stays free for the conversation.

maxResultChars.description: Hard absolute cap on returned chars regardless of remaining context.

minResultChars.description: Floor for the per-result char budget so tiny remaining windows still yield a usable sliver.
